The 2026-07-24 Tau Ceti throwaway export/build predates the real-valued approximation-number conversion, Courant--Fischer redesign, dependency splits, and unified operator-modulus API; it is historical evidence only. Re-export the dependency-closed module list computed from current imports and rerun strict Tau Ceti validation before submission.

records.provenance_class: redesigned: the free-data presentation (membership plus a total real gauge constrained only on members, one universe, hand-rolled completeness, fourteen fields) is replaced by a single `ℝ≥0∞` gauge with the ideal derived as its finiteness domain, giving structural extensionality and unconditional laws; space parameters are Hilbert, see the module docstring for why the Banach setting has no instance beyond the operator norm
